svg.title: The ka-tet: seven seats of an orchestral agentic AI system
svg.desc: The Master, who is human, and six agent seats: the Dinh, the Gunslinger, the Second Gunslinger, the Archivist, the Balladeer and Cort, with their disciplines, cylinder sizes, publish rights and repositories. Only the Archivist publishes. Measured 2026-10-15.
